# SAMHSA - Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration

> SAMHSA is the federal agency providing data, resources, and support for substance use treatment and mental health services across the United States.

SAMHSA operates the Center for Behavioral Health Statistics and Quality (CBHSQ), which maintains major national surveys and datasets including NSDUH, TEDS, N-SUMHSS, and MH-CLD. The agency offers grants, treatment locators, crisis helplines, and comprehensive behavioral health information to support public health and treatment outcomes.

## Key Topics

- SAMHSA
- CBHSQ (Center for Behavioral Health Statistics and Quality)
- NSDUH (National Survey on Drug Use and Health)
- N-SUMHSS (National Substance Use and Mental Health Services Survey)

## Core Resources

- [Home | SAMHSA](https://www.samhsa.gov): SAMHSA homepage with mental health, substance abuse resources and crisis helplines
- [About Us](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/about-us): SAMHSA organizational overview and mission within HHS and CBHSQ
- [SAMHSA Grants Dashboard](https://www.samhsa.gov/grants/grants-dashboard): Dashboard for accessing SAMHSA grants, funding resources and treatment locators

## Data Collections and Surveys

- [Data Collections Overview](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/data-we-collect): Overview of SAMHSA data collections including MH-CLD and MH-TEDS datasets
- [NSDUH - National Survey on Drug Use and Health](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/data-we-collect/nsduh-national-survey-drug-use-and-health): NSDUH resources, tools, and national drug use and health survey data analysis
- [N-SUMHSS - National Substance Use and Mental Health Services Survey](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/data-we-collect/n-sumhss-national-substance-use-and-mental-health-services-survey): N-SUMHSS resources for substance use and mental health services survey data
- [TEDS - Treatment Episode Data Set](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/data-we-collect/teds-treatment-episode-data-set): TEDS treatment episode data resources, downloads and visualization tools
- [MH-CLD - Mental Health Client-Level Data](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/data-we-collect/mh-cld-mental-health-client-level-data): MH-CLD mental health client-level data resources and analysis tools
- [DAWN - Drug Abuse Warning Network](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/data-we-collect/dawn-drug-abuse-warning-network): DAWN drug abuse warning network data on emergency visits and substance trends
- [URS - Uniform Reporting System](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/data-we-collect/urs-uniform-reporting-system): URS uniform reporting system resources and SMI/SED prevalence estimates

## Data Analysis and Tools

- [NSDUH State Estimates](https://datatools.samhsa.gov/saes/state): Interactive NSDUH state estimates tool with prevalence trends and comparisons
- [Quick Statistics](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/quick-statistics): Quick statistics on substance use treatment and mental health services data
- [All Reports](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/all-reports): NSDUH reports, methodology resources and substance use and mental health data

## Publications and Guidelines

- [SAMHSA Library](https://library.samhsa.gov): SAMHSA publications library with treatment guidelines and behavioral health resources
- [Program Evaluations](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/program-evaluations): SAMHSA program evaluation methodology and 21st Century Cures Act compliance

## Support and Information

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/faq): FAQs about SAMHSA surveys, data resources and treatment data access
